limitations: Keyword-based gap detection, not semantic analysis
Single RBI circular analyzed per report
Mock bank policy used for demonstration
HTML content extraction may lose formatting
assumptions: RBI guidelines extracted from RSS feed are complete
Bank policy is stored in current_policy.json format
Manual compliance verification required before regulatory submission

conclusion.summary: The PoC demonstrates automated RBI compliance extraction, gap detection, and audit-ready reporting through deterministic file-based processing.
conclusion.next_phase_readiness: Ready for CBS integration, multi-circular scaling, and production deployment
